target.title: fix(ai): preserve thinking blocks on historical turns with tool calls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users disabling reasoning playback (setting `replayThinkingEnabled` to `false` or reasoning to `off`) would encounter Anthropic API validation errors on subsequent turns of a conversation that contained tool calls. This happened because removing the `thinking` block from historical assistant turns that also contain `tool_use` blocks violates Anthropic's API schema requirements (which mandate that a tool-use block must be accompanied by its preceding thinking block in the assistant turn).

## Why This Change Was Made

Modified the thinking block cleanup logic in `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` to preserve thinking blocks for any historical assistant turns that contain one or more tool calls, even when `replayThinkingEnabled` is configured to `false`.

## User Impact

Prevents conversation crashes and API validation errors on Anthropic models when reasoning is turned off and the agent makes tool calls.

## Evidence

Added unit test `preserves thinking blocks in history assistant turns containing tool calls even when replayThinkingEnabled is false` in `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts` (passed all 51 tests).

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified via test execution output:
```
 ✓ |unit| packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts (51 tests) 100ms
```
When `replayThinkingEnabled` is false, previously all historical assistant turns had their thinking blocks stripped. If those assistant turns also contained tool calls, they were sent to Anthropic with only `tool_use` blocks and no `thinking` block, causing API validation failure. With this fix, we preserve thinking blocks for historical turns that contain one or more tool calls, keeping Anthropic API requests valid.
